review_evidences.text_zh: 与相似亲本杂交相比，宽杂交-WGD耦合的趋势更高，至少有两种相互包含的解释：(1)宽杂交更容易产生未减少的配子9 - 12；(2)WGD通过增强自合二价配对恢复正常的减数分裂，而多价和异合二价配对导致来自更相似二倍体祖先的多倍体减数分裂异常的频率更高13。

review_evidences.text: In addition to overcoming meiotic instabilities14,15, nascent polyploids also face challenges associated with establishment and/or persistence.

review_evidences.text: Together, our findings unravel an unexpected evolutionary potential of HE-catalysed ‘allo-to-auto’ polyploidy-type transition and point to the feasibility for rapid generation of new polyploid crops by induced WGD of diploid hybrids that are prezygotically compatible but postzygotically isolated (or largely so) at the homoploid level30–34.
review_evidences.text_zh: 总之，我们的研究结果揭示了he催化的“同种异体到自异体”多倍体型转化的意想不到的进化潜力，并指出了通过诱导WGD快速产生新的多倍体作物的可行性，这些二倍体杂种在同倍体水平上是前合子相容性的，但在合子后分离（或很大程度上如此）。

review_evidences.text: Moreover, we find that some high-yielding TRILs also showed transgressive resilience to two important abiotic stresses, although in their propagation process no such conditions were applied.

review_evidences.text: Indeed, this has been observed in synthetic polyploids of several other plant taxa after multigenerational selection for higher fertility13,74.
review_evidences.text_zh: 事实上，这已经在其他几个植物类群的合成多倍体中观察到，这些多倍体经过多代选择以获得更高的育性[13,74]。

review_evidences.text: Because meiosis stability is often causally linked to fertility in neopolyploidy, it may be suggested that autopolyploidy might rapidly evolve stable meiosis.

review_evidences.text: Together, it may be suggested that rapid evolution of meiotic stability in newly formed plant polyploids is probably a common biological property, consistent with the often recurrent and ubiquitous occurrence of historical WGDs in the entire plant kingdom1,5,23,75.
review_evidences.text_zh: 综上所述，新形成的植物多倍体减数分裂稳定性的快速进化可能是一种共同的生物学特性，这与整个植物界历史上经常反复出现和普遍存在的WGDs一致1,5,23,75。

review_evidences.text: Thus, under circumstances where these two essential conditions (that is, moderate parental genetic divergence and absence of HPS) are met, HE by itself appears to be a potent driver of evolutionarily relevant diversification under polyploidy.
review_evidences.text_zh: 因此，在满足这两个基本条件（即亲本遗传分化适度和HPS缺失）的情况下，HE本身似乎是多倍体下进化相关多样化的有力驱动因素。

review_evidences.text: Notwithstanding a burgeoning literature on the rapid genomic and expression-level changes accompanying polyploidy, the extent to which these mechanisms collectively generate evolutionarily meaningful phenotypic variation in newly formed polyploids remains fragmented, as well as mostly unobserved in natural settings.
